text:
Priya (Content): Draft ready for review — product launch post (focus: predictable inference economics). Link to internal draft: https://internal.redwood/launch-draft. Need quick pass on hero claim, benchmark appendix, webinar hook, and inbound lead routing. (1716129999)

Maya (Marketing): Skimmed — nice structure. Can we tighten the hero claim? 'Reduce inference cost by 3x' needs provenance or we should hedge. Also want a stronger webinar CTA up top.

Priya (Content): Current hero: "Reduce per-token cost by up to 3x for steady-state workloads." Benchmarks live in section 3 (Llama-2 13B on A100 40GB, 512 token runs) — will link appendix. CTA currently: Register for launch webinar + gated benchmark PDF.

Sam (Product): Quick product note: avoid naming specific model versions in the public post. Suggest: 'widely used open models' + link to appendix with methods. Also add a short canary note about Dedicated capacity in the rollout section.

Ethan (Growth): Routing + funnel thoughts: Blog -> gated benchmark PDF -> webinar signup. HubSpot: tag downloads as "launch_benchmark_2024" and webinar_signups as "launch_webinar_2024". Then workflows to SDR queue by segment: trial-ready, webinar-attendee, PDF-downloader. I can own the mapping.

Ava (Design): Uploaded hero comp to Figma. Need a 1-line social variant and a short alt for the hero image. I'll mock two CTA button styles.

Priya (Content): Legal — @LegalBot can you quick-pass the "up to 3x" phrasing and the benchmark methodology? Attached micro-bench notes in the doc.

LegalBot (Legal): Quick flag: "up to 3x" is acceptable if benchmarks and methods are clearly linked and the copy avoids absolutes like "always" or "guaranteed". Ensure the gated PDF includes test harness, seed prompts, and hardware info. Don't include customer names without consent.

Priya (Content): Thanks. Ops — @Ned (Ops) can we support expected traffic for gated PDF and webinar? Also need an alerting play if downloads spike.

Ned (Ops): We can host the webinar up to 500 concurrent viewers via the existing vendor. For gated PDF, serve via S3 signed URLs + CloudFront with rate limiting. I'll add a Lambda to throttle and an alert to #eng-oncall for >2x baseline download rate.

Sam (Product): Routing details from product side: suggested lead segments — 
- trial-ready: product usage > 3 evals or > 10 endpoint calls in first 7 days
- webinar-attendee: attended live or watched recording within 7 days
- gated-pdf-download: downloaded benchmark asset
Tag all leads with "launch_2024_benchmark" and set workflow to score + route to SDR.

Ethan (Growth): I'll implement HubSpot workflows. Success metrics: MQLs from gated PDF + webinar signups. Target: 250 PDF downloads, 150 webinar signups, 30 MQLs in first 2 weeks.

Ava (Design): Social copy options:
1) "Ship LLM features faster — with predictable inference economics."
2) "Predictable, fast LLM inference."
Which do we prefer for hero/LinkedIn?

Maya (Marketing): Option 1 for LinkedIn and hero, option 2 for Twitter/X. Also propose publish time: Tue 10:00 AM PT, webinar Wed 11:00 AM PT (allows 24h notice).

LegalBot (Legal): Timing is fine. Remember to set embargo fields in HubSpot for press outreach and remove product references that might imply SLAs.

Priya (Content): Okay final asks before locking: marketing approve hero copy, product approve routing and quote, ops approve delivery and throttles, design approve hero image, legal approve claims. Please respond with :thumbsup: to approve.

Maya (Marketing): :thumbsup: Marketing approves.

Sam (Product): :thumbsup: Product approves. Please add a short CTO quote (1-2 sentences) and I'll get it.

Ned (Ops): :thumbsup: Ops approves capacity + alerting plan.

Ava (Design): :thumbsup: Design approves hero + social variants.

LegalBot (Legal): :thumbsup: Legal approves the phrasing and gating approach.

Priya (Content): Thanks everyone — I'll lock the draft, upload the gated PDF to S3, set the HubSpot tags, and queue the publish. Publishing checklist: copy locked, hero image, gated PDF uploaded, HubSpot workflows, webinar invite sent. ETA: locking by EOD.

OpsBot (DeployBot): publish_job #482 queued for 2024-02-13T17:00:00Z — blog_publish workflow added to the queue.

Priya (Content): Added calendar invites and demo recording slot. If anything else pops up, please ping me directly in this thread or in #launch-ops.
